title: One state observation in a character's timeline
description: Append-only. The current value of an attribute is the last entry for it, so ordinary change needs no retcon — which is the whole point: a character walking to another room is not a continuity error.

attribute.description: From the controlled vocabulary (location, holds, mood, condition, companions, goal). Free-form names produce one attribute per event and a canon that never supersedes anything.
